description: This file defines a Security controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for security-related operations such as listing security status, moving directories, renaming admin directories, and deleting sensitive directories. It manages server-side logic for security features in the admin backend.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Controller class managing security-related actions in the OpenCart admin area, including directory checks, renaming, and deletion to ensure security.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads language, controller, and view for security overview.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of security status information by calling another controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns data about installation, storage, and admin directory statuses, used to assess security vulnerabilities.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation directory cleanup after permission checks, deletes install folder.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Moves storage directories to new locations with validation, updating configuration files accordingly.

methods.name: storage_delete
methods.description: Deletes the storage directory if permitted.

methods.name: admin
methods.description: Renames the admin directory to a new, user-specified name, with permission and existence checks.

methods.name: admin_delete
methods.description: Deletes the admin directory if permitted.
